journeySteps.title: Started as Educators
journeySteps.description: We began by teaching people software testing fundamentals. Not just theory, but real-world practices. We upgraded levels from middle to senior, not just beginners.
journeySteps.highlight: Teaching others forced us to master quality ourselves.

journeySteps.title: Built a Learning Community
journeySteps.description: Engineers started coming together to share knowledge, discuss failures, and learn from each other's experiences.

journeySteps.title: From Teaching to Practicing
journeySteps.description: Our deep understanding of quality principles naturally evolved into providing QA services to real products.

journeySteps.title: Learning from the Best
journeySteps.description: We studied practices from Google, Amazon, Netflix, and other tech giants. Not to copy, but to understand and adapt.

journeySteps.title: People-First Approach
journeySteps.description: We realized that quality is built by people, not just processes. People became our core value.

journeySteps.title: Pain-Driven Innovation
journeySteps.description: Client challenges pushed us to create better solutions. Their pain points became our innovation fuel.

journeySteps.title: Creating New Standards
journeySteps.description: We stopped following trends and started setting them. Defining what “new normal” means in QA.
